lessons_used: Evidence remains thin for all specific kinds of change, as each category has only been tested once.
Adoption redesign (adoption, redesign) was helpful and is the only tested change that won (+3.6% after noise correction).
Sign-in hints, waiting screen status info, finish notifications, and path selection redesigns showed no clear effect.
Reordering sign-in and path selection card layout changes made performance worse.
Predictions were mostly too high across tests, except for the path selection redesign where the prediction was too low (-2.0% predicted vs +0.7% noise-corrected).
carried_retests: Spotlight Desktop Controls Overview on Finish Screen

candidates.title: Spotlight Layout for Adoption Certificate
candidates.change: Redesign the adoption certificate screen using a spotlight layout to highlight the pet preview and official sign-off.
candidates.why: Adoption has a high drop-off rate (65.9% conversion) and previous adoption redesign tests showed positive results (+3.6%).

guard.reason: Redesigning the adoption certificate layout maintains all required elements and functionality.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has high drop-off (34.1%) and adoption redesign is the only historically proven winner (+3.6%).

candidates.title: Pet Style Selector Screen Before Path Choice
candidates.change: Insert a visual pet style preference screen right after the story screen to build instant visual interest.
candidates.why: Choose path screen has a long mean time of 514s; engaging users early with visual pet themes improves interest.

new_pet_style_selector.headline: Choose Your Pet Style
new_pet_style_selector.body: Select the visual theme for your desktop companion.

guard.reason: Adding a new screen inside onboarding is explicitly allowed.

candidates.score_note: Adding a new screen increases friction, and previous path selection changes performed poorly.

candidates.title: Live Pet Preview Component for Custom Creation
candidates.change: Replace the static photo upload interface with an interactive live pet preview rendering element.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails about custom pets failing or looking wrong; showing a live preview ensures user expectations match output.

guard.reason: 'upload_photos.replace.photo_upload[0]': a preview cannot do the photo_upload job (use ['button', 'checklist', 'image', 'photo_picker', 'text'])

candidates.title: Stage Layout Companion Animation for Waiting Screen
candidates.change: Redesign the waiting screen into a full stage layout featuring an animated pet mascot companion.
candidates.why: Waiting on the home step takes a median of 201s and mean of 2336s; visual stage animations keep users engaged while loading.

guard.reason: Redesigning the waiting screen layout and adding visual components inside onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Long waiting times on home step, but full animation redesign requires significant effort for modest expected lift.

candidates.title: Existing Account Warning Hint on Sign-In
candidates.change: Display a hint on sign-in warning users to use their existing account to avoid pet resets.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails (the largest complaint category) about pets missing or reset after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Signing in with your existing account keeps all your pets and progress safe.

guard.reason: Adding an informative sign-in hint does not violate fair design or any base rules.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from support (8 complaints) and low cost; previous sign-in hint test yielded +1.5%.

candidates.title: Desktop Companionship Story Copy Reframing
candidates.change: Update the story screen copy to focus directly on having a live interactive pet on your desktop.
candidates.why: Choose_path has a 76.2% conversion rate; setting clear expectations early reduces initial drop-off.

story.headline: Your Always-On Desktop Companion
story.body: Bring a friendly pet to life right on your desktop to keep you company, play, and interact throughout your day.

guard.reason: Updating story copy to introduce the desktop pet companion fulfills the screen's job.

candidates.score_note: Low cost copy tweak, but evidence and historical impact for copy/path changes remain weak.

candidates.title: Adoption Verification Badge Incentive
candidates.change: Add an official adoption verification badge component on the adoption certificate screen.
candidates.why: Adoption step drops 34.1% of users; highlighting official adoption status increases completion motivation.

guard.reason: Adding an official adoption badge component to the certificate screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Adoption step has high drop-off; adding a verification incentive badge can improve completion motivation.

candidates.title: Desktop Shortcut Tip Carousel on Waiting Screen
candidates.change: Add a tip carousel component to the waiting screen explaining how to interact with the pet once loaded.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails about confusion on how to control or speak to the pet, and median waiting time is 201s.

components.text: Quick Tip: Right-click your desktop pet anytime to bring up controls or chat.

guard.reason: Adding helpful desktop shortcut tips to the waiting screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Supported by support complaints (3 emails) and long funnel wait times; wait_info previously gained +2.0%.

candidates.title: Two-Column Layout for Home Intro Screen
candidates.change: Switch the home intro screen layout to a two-column structure separating the welcome greeting from control actions.
candidates.why: Finish step has a low 64.8% conversion and high median completion time of 395s.

guard.reason: Redesigning the home intro layout is allowed as home intro is part of onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Finish step has high drop-off (35.2%), but layout changes have historically shown negative or negligible impact.

candidates.title: Pet Temperament Selection Screen
candidates.change: Insert a pet temperament selection screen prior to adoption certificate signing.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion is only 65.9%; letting users customize pet personality builds emotional connection before finalizing.

new_pet_temperament.headline: Select Pet Temperament
new_pet_temperament.body: Choose whether your desktop companion is energetic, calm, or playful.

guard.reason: Inserting a new pet temperament screen into the onboarding flow is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Adding an extra pre-adoption screen introduces friction despite adoption's high drop-off.

decisions.outcome: lost: did not hold up in re-test

lessons_next: Sign-in hints (sign_in, hint) consistently showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Adoption redesign (adoption, redesign) was helpful in one confirmed winning test, though a second test showed no clear effect.
Evidence remains thin for most other specific categories (path layout/copy/redesign, home status/redesign, finish notification/redesign, sign-in reordering) as each has only been tested once.
Predictions were generally too high across most tests, with rare exceptions where impact was underestimated (such as desktop story copy and path redesign).
